content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-143","Title":"completeTurn persist fails after session-id rebind","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["workflow.sessionlog.completeTurn in plugins/core/lib-ps/repl-invoke.ps1 re-binds current-turn.yaml from a rotated sessionId to the active session (TR-MCP-PLUGIN-012 / BUG-TRIAGE-071/075), then Invoke-ReplPersistTurn submits the pre-rotation requestId against Get-ReplSessionMeta\u0027s new sessionId. SubmitAsync fails, the write-ahead ReplFailsafe record is left on disk, completeTurn returns false, and wrap-up closeout stays blocked even when session-start reports the plugin available.","Triage group: triage-group-1ea7fdfa3dd96cb2","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- After Start-PluginSession rotates session-state.yaml sessionId while current-turn.yaml still holds a pre-rotation turnRequestId and matching marker, workflow.sessionlog.completeTurn returns true and marks that turn completed.","- completeTurn after a sessionId-only rebind does not leave an uncleared ReplFailsafe session_submit record when the plugin backend is reachable.","- Wrap-up closeout succeeds on the same requestId that was opened before session rotation without requiring a new beginTurn.","Implementation notes:","- Assert-ReplCurrentTurnFresh already rewrites current-turn.yaml sessionId and is not the failing step; the gap is persist identity. Invoke-ReplPersistTurn always uses Get-ReplSessionMeta.SessionId (active) plus the cached turnRequestId (pre-rotation).","- Prefer one of: persist against the original sessionId captured before rebind; import/supersede the old turn into the active session then complete that request; or begin and complete a replacement turn on the active session and close the stale cache. Do not treat leftover failsafe as success.","- Canonical site is plugins/core/lib-ps/repl-invoke.ps1 (Invoke-WorkflowCompleteTurn, Assert-ReplCurrentTurnFresh, Invoke-ReplPersistTurn). Mirror any contract change in the Codex plugin shim if it still copies this path."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
